results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the formatting and layout of articles so that I can create visually appealing content that engages readers effectively.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors should be able to customize at least 5 key visual elements (font styles, colors, images, spacing, and alignment) to enhance article aesthetics.
- The article preview feature must update in real-time, ensuring at least 95% accuracy in displaying changes made during editing.
- User feedback should indicate a satisfaction rate of at least 85% regarding the visual appeal of articles after implementing these controls.

Test Outline:
- Assess the customization options available to editors and verify that all specified elements can be modified as intended.
- Conduct user testing with a sample of readers to evaluate their perception of article visuals before and after the enhancements.

As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article formatting and layout so that I can create visually appealing articles that engage readers effectively.

Test Outline:

- Conduct usability testing with editors to ensure real-time previews accurately reflect final published articles.

- Conduct user surveys post-publication to measure reader satisfaction regarding the visual appeal of the articles.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a website visitor, I want a search bar prominently located at the top of the page so that I can easily access and navigate to the content I am looking for without unnecessary scrolling.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar should be visible and accessible on the top of every page, appearing within 1 second of page load for 95% of users.
- Users should be able to input search queries with a character limit of at least 100 characters and receive relevant results with a minimum accuracy rate of 85%.
- The search function must include autocomplete suggestions that display at least 5 relevant options as users type their queries.

Test Outline:
- Test the visibility and loading time of the search bar across multiple devices and browsers to ensure consistency.
- Evaluate the functionality of the search bar by conducting user tests to assess the accuracy and relevance of the search results and autocomplete suggestions.

User Story:
As a user, I want a prominently placed search bar at the top of the page so that I can conveniently access search functionality and quickly locate relevant content.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be visible on the top of the page without scrolling for 100% of users accessing the site.
- Users should be able to initiate a search within 2 clicks, with a completion rate of at least 95% for search queries.
- The search bar should support autocomplete suggestions to improve user efficiency, with a suggestion accuracy of at least 80%.

Test Outline:
- Verify the visibility of the search bar on various devices and screen sizes to ensure it meets design specifications.
- Conduct usability testing to measure the time taken for users to perform a search and gather feedback on the effectiveness of autocomplete suggestions.
